description: Approved climate-analysis thresholds. The LLM/frontend should choose from these options rather than invent thresholds at query time.

tasmax.label: Daily maximum near-surface air temperature
notes: Use for dry/ambient daily maximum heat exposure.

wet_bulb_temperature.label: Wet-bulb temperature
notes: Use for humid-heat stress. Interpret separately from Tmax thresholds.

apparent_temperature.label: Apparent temperature
notes: Use for forecast heat-stress style analysis when available.
